spans.boundary_evidence: MFSDelete begins after the TFSDIR2 MvEx1 branch at 0x40472c. AdjFlPos ends with RTS at 0x404850. SetFilType begins TFSDIR3 at 0x404852.

changes.change: Retained the surviving instruction sequence without behavioral reversions.
changes.evidence: MFSDelete, RemovEntry, MFSReName, and AdjFlPos reproduce all 294 ROM bytes. The ROM retains the October 1985 cache flushes, A6 stack handling, and updates to open-file directory positions.

changes.change: Kept the surviving fsRnErr symbol and its original value. Preserved the original header, applicable history, and comments.
changes.evidence: The source marks the symbol spelling as a September 1986 equate update. Its value of -59 matches the immediate result at 0x404826. The code therefore needs no behavioral change.

changes.change: Copied required original equates, supplied external routine addresses, and made PC-relative JSR operands explicit.
changes.evidence: The calls to TrashFBlocks and MarkBlock use PC-relative JSR instructions at 0x404758 and 0x40477c. CmpString emits 0xa03c at 0x4047b4. All ten recorded labels match the ROM.

verification.method: Reconstruction/Tools/verify.py assembled for the 68000, linked at 0x40472c, and compared every emitted byte and all recorded labels against the ROM.
limits: The comparison proves emitted bytes and label positions. It does not execute file operations, disk writes, memory handling, or asynchronous operations.
External routines and trap implementations lie outside this span. Their referenced addresses and opcodes are checked here, but their implementations and runtime dispatch are not.

The original Mac Plus source and historical assembler output remain unavailable. Restored expressions and comments explain the verified ROM behavior; they do not establish the exact original spelling.
